summary: A disc-shaped cichlid from central and eastern Amazonian waters. It favours quiet floodplain and flooded-forest habitats; captive strains are popular, but their warm-water and water-quality needs require careful husbandry.
nativeRange: Central and eastern Amazon basin below the Purus Arch.

features: Deep, rounded body flattened from side to side.
Blue and brown wild forms; aquarium strains show many additional colours and patterns.
The fins do not extend into the long points seen on freshwater angelfish.

habitat.description: Floodplain lakes and flooded forests, often sheltering around fallen trees.
habitat.diet: Plant matter and detritus as well as worms and small crustaceans.
